title: State Filing Desk Note: Name Changes While the State Still Has to Answer the Certificate (Cardinal Financial Responsibility Filing)
content:
The pending-version name charge on a name amendment of a Cardinal Financial Responsibility Filing certificate follows whether the state still has to answer the certificate — that is, the filing status and the date of the latest transmission on the filing's record — and is worked from the name-amendment rate.

| Filing status | Latest transmission on the filing's record | Pending-version name charge |
|---|---|---|
| Filed | Sent today | Half the name-amendment rate, rounded down to the whole dollar |
| Filed | Sent on an earlier day | Three quarters of the name-amendment rate, rounded up to the whole dollar |
| Any other status (accepted, cancel-notified and the rest) | Any | The name-amendment rate as it stands |

## Figures (hypothetical rates)

| Name-amendment rate | Filed, latest sent today | Filed, latest sent earlier | Other status |
|---|---|---|---|
| 15.00 | 7.50, rounded down: 7.00 | 11.25, rounded up: 12.00 | 15.00 |
| 5.00 | 2.50, rounded down: 2.00 | 3.75, rounded up: 4.00 | 5.00 |
| 20.00 | 10.00 | 15.00 | 20.00 |

"Sent today" means the latest transmission on the filing's record carries today's transmission date.
